name: Varbase Carousels
description: This feature provides the base implementation for the carousels in your website. Admins will be able to create carousels on the spot and place it anywhere in the site.
library_dependencies: slick (kenwheeler/slick JS; loaded via the slick module, README asks for slick.min.js in /libraries)
project_description:
Provides the base implementation for the carousels in your website.

 Admins will be able to create carousels on the spot and place it anywhere on the site.
